name: Edgar Degas
findings: Within his own canvases, scheele's green turns up as a small accent in 71% of the paintings that hold it, 1.7x the archive's rate (from 2005 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, green grey turns up as the lightest note in 75% of the paintings that hold it, 2.3x the archive's rate (from 2005 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, reddish brown turns up as the shadow in 54% of the paintings that hold it, 1.8x the archive's rate (from 2005 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2005 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2005 paintings here).
Pairs cadet blue with pastel turquoise more than chance would predict (3 of 2005 paintings here).
Pairs cadet grey with silver grey more than chance would predict (3 of 2005 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, raisin black, platinum) covers 59% of his paintings here.
